correctness.rationale: The lower-shift matrix is nilpotent and Hurwitz after any nonempty pinned set, so its explicit impulse kernel yields the exact binomial segment cost. A strictly positive discrete second difference forces every minimizing gap vector to balance. The n/k binomial count is from distinguished-leader double counting. The near-critical integral follows from a uniform central-binomial bound and a split Riemann sum; the far-critical regime follows from exact binomial generating functions with explicit error control. A standalone exact-rational covariance recurrence checks 33 Lyapunov blocks and exhaustively verifies all 6105 small-ring leader selections; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Sharp, fully enumerated placement designs for any finite one-way ring and all nonzero gains are useful in noise-limited directed formation design. The critical scale n(1-rho)=Theta(1) separates nonnormal \(n^{3/2}\) total-error growth with k-dependent leading constant from linear attenuated growth where fixed k does not affect that constant; the explicit crossover function quantifies robustness to coupling attenuation. This is a motivated network-design and scaling result, not a renaming of the known singly rooted variance identity.
